piratesmca.flag.title: Crew flag
piratesmca.flag.requirements: Nearby volunteers: %s. You need 2 free adult pirates within 14 blocks, at least 0 MCA hearts, morale 35+ and fear below 80. Meet them first; pirates in a brawl will not join.
piratesmca.flag.link_help: Link your crew to this flag. It becomes the rally point.
piratesmca.flag.orders_help: Rally and guard use this flag, within 64 blocks. Sailors may refuse orders.
piratesmca.flag.other_crew: This flag belongs to another crew. Only its captain can command here.
piratesmca.flag.too_far: Approach a visible crew flag (within 6 blocks).
piratesmca.flag.occupied: This flag is claimed, or you do not have authority to link it.
piratesmca.flag.not_enough: Two volunteers are required. Befriend the pirates and try again.
piratesmca.flag.founded: Crew founded! You are the captain; two volunteers joined your flag.
piratesmca.flag.linked: Crew flag linked. Rally and guard now use this point.
piratesmca.wearable.denied: Only the captain or an operator can change this preset.
piratesmca.wearable.occupied: Head slot occupied or preset unavailable.
piratesmca.outfit.denied: Use on a nearby adult pirate in your crew, or as an operator.
piratesmca.outfit.updated: Outfit updated; appearance and equipment preserved.
piratesmca.outfit.unavailable: Outfit unavailable, already equipped, or changed by another selection.

piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.greeting.01: Ahoy! Care for a story, or just a seat by the fire?
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.greeting.02: Easy there, friend. Our flag looks scarier than our cook.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.greeting.03: A new face on deck! Welcome, provided you don't steal my hammock.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.greeting.04: Good to see dry boots. Mine haven't been dry in three voyages.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.greeting.05: Come closer! The captain only bites before breakfast.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.greeting.06: Ahoy, traveler! You look like someone who knows a good shortcut.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.smalltalk.0: We name every storm. Makes it easier to complain about them later.
I learned to read from a waterlogged treasure map. Half the words were fish.
There's a villager who sends me letters. Never learned how to answer without a ship.
A good crew shares stories. A great crew knows which stories are lies.
Sometimes I miss solid ground. Then I remember how expensive a house is.
My first voyage was three days long. I was seasick for four.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.sea.01: The sea has no roads, but it remembers every keel.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.sea.02: Never sail by the stars alone. Watch the birds, the wind, and the color of the water.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.sea.03: I once watched dolphins guide us out of a reef. Best pilots I ever hired.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.sea.04: When the waves glow at night, I stay awake just to watch.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.sea.05: I like a calm harbor, but a horizon with no end is hard to resist.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.sea.06: If you hear the hull sing, check the wind before you check for ghosts.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.treasure.01: Gold's fine, but the real prize is a map nobody has finished.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.treasure.02: I buried a chest once. Forgot where. Might have been my laundry.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.treasure.03: Every good treasure hunt starts with a bad drawing.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.treasure.04: Keep the emeralds. I want the compass that points somewhere impossible.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.treasure.05: If we find treasure together, we split it before anyone gets clever.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.treasure.06: The best chest I opened was full of letters. Someone had loved that sailor.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.trade.01: I've got rope, fish, and a spoon I swear is enchanted. Interested?
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.trade.02: Fair trade first, haggling second. That's how you keep your fingers.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.trade.03: A barrel of apples is worth more than diamonds halfway through a voyage.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.trade.04: I'll pay extra for a decent map. The last one sent us into a swamp.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.trade.05: Got any bread? The ship's biscuits could patch a stone wall.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.trade.06: No cheating from my side of the counter. The captain counts every coin.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.captain.01: Our captain listens to everyone. Doesn't always agree, but listens.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.captain.02: A captain earns a chair at the table, not a crown over the crew.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.captain.03: I've seen captains who could steer through thunder and couldn't say sorry.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.captain.04: When the captain makes a mistake, we remind them. Quietly. Usually.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.captain.05: The bravest order our captain gave was 'turn back for the missing sailor.'
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.captain.06: If you command a ship, learn everyone's name before you learn the cannons.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.crew.01: No one eats alone on this ship, unless they've stolen the dessert.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.crew.02: Our lookout is afraid of heights. Still spots trouble before the rest of us.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.crew.03: We argue like siblings and row like one creature when trouble comes.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.crew.04: There's always room for another pair of hands, if they pull their weight.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.crew.05: I trust the cook with my life. Not with a recipe, mind you.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.crew.06: On deck, we share the work before we share the loot.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.loyalty.01: Loyalty is coming back for the last person in the water.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.loyalty.02: A promise made on deck weighs more than a chest of gold.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.loyalty.03: If you help one of us, the rest will remember.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.loyalty.04: You don't have to like every crewmate to stand beside them.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.loyalty.05: A flag means nothing if nobody beneath it looks after you.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.loyalty.06: I've sailed with thieves who kept their word better than kings.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.rumor.01: Word is there's a wreck beyond the kelp forest. Nothing but bubbles at dawn.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.rumor.02: They say the old lighthouse lights itself when a storm is coming.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.rumor.03: Someone found a golden bell in a drowned ruin. Now every sailor wants one.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.rumor.04: Heard a merchant bought a pirate flag to scare off actual pirates. Clever fool.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.rumor.05: A strange current has been carrying empty boats into the bay.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.rumor.06: Don't repeat it, but our navigator is following a map drawn by a child.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.danger.01: Storm coming. Help me tie this down before the deck turns into a river.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.danger.02: Stay behind the rail! I've got the rope; you grab the ladder.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.danger.03: Those sails on the horizon aren't friendly. Keep your head low.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.danger.04: If fighting starts, find cover. Heroics can wait until we're all alive.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.danger.05: There's a leak below deck. Bring planks, not questions.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.danger.06: Hold on to something. The sea's about to rearrange this whole ship.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.gift.01: For me? Then you get the first cup of cocoa when we reach shore.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.gift.02: This is worth more than you think. Thank you, truly.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.gift.03: I'll keep it tucked away where the sea can't reach it.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.gift.04: You remembered! Now I owe you a favor, and I don't forget those.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.gift.05: You didn't need to bring anything. But I'm glad you did.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.gift.06: A gift without a bargain attached? That's rare in these waters.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.farewell.01: Fair winds, friend. Leave a lantern on if you want us back.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.farewell.02: Until the tide brings us together again!
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.farewell.03: Keep your boots dry and your compass honest.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.farewell.04: If you hear someone singing badly at sea, that's probably us.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.farewell.05: May your next harbor have warm food and no tax collector.
piratesmca.dialogue.friendly.farewell.06: Take care! I'll save you a place near the fire.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.greeting.01: State your business. Then get out of the doorway.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.greeting.02: You're late. For what? Doesn't matter. You're late.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.greeting.03: Hmph. Another landwalker asking about the sea.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.greeting.04: If you've come to stare, at least bring supplies.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.greeting.05: Speak up. The wind took half my hearing and all my patience.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.greeting.06: Don't step on that rope. That's the only warning you're getting.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.smalltalk.01: Had a quiet morning. Then everyone started talking.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.smalltalk.02: I hate seagulls. Loud thieves with wings.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.smalltalk.03: The cook burned the stew again. I ate two bowls to make a point.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.smalltalk.04: Sleep is a luxury. A dry blanket's a miracle.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.smalltalk.05: I don't tell stories. I give warnings with an inconvenient amount of detail.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.smalltalk.06: That scar? Rope burn. The other one? Also rope burn. Stop asking.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.sea.01: The ocean doesn't care how brave you feel. Remember that.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.sea.02: A calm sea makes fools think they're captains.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.sea.03: The tide has more discipline than half this crew.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.sea.04: If the water goes still all at once, start worrying.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.sea.05: I trust a creaking mast more than a smiling merchant.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.sea.06: Waves don't negotiate. Keep your footing.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.treasure.01: If your map says X, check who drew the X before digging.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.treasure.02: I've seen men kill over an empty chest. Idiots, all of them.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.treasure.03: Gold sinks just as fast as stone. Don't forget it.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.treasure.04: Treasure isn't treasure until you make it home with it.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.treasure.05: Keep your shovel sharp and your expectations low.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.treasure.06: I once dug up a chest full of rotten potatoes. Still ate better that week.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.trade.01: Price is on the barrel. I don't do poetry or discounts.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.trade.02: Your emeralds are good. Your bargaining isn't.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.trade.03: Show me the goods before you tell me they're rare.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.trade.04: If it's wet, broken, or cursed, the price goes down.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.trade.05: I can fix your gear. I can't fix your judgment.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.trade.06: Try that price again and I'll charge you for wasting daylight.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.captain.01: A captain who shouts all day has nothing worth saying.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.captain.02: I follow orders that keep the crew breathing. The others get questions.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.captain.03: The wheel doesn't make someone a leader. Responsibility does.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.captain.04: If the captain wants respect, they can start by earning it.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.captain.05: I served under three captains. Buried one. Fired another.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.captain.06: When I say the hull needs repairs, that's not an invitation to debate.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.crew.01: They're fools. They're my fools. There's a difference.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.crew.02: We work together because drowning separately is stupid.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.crew.03: The deckhand talks too much. Still, nobody touches them on my watch.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.crew.04: Pull your weight and nobody cares where you came from.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.crew.05: First rule of this crew: don't leave your mess for the next shift.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.crew.06: If you borrow my knife, return it clean. Preferably immediately.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.loyalty.01: I don't hand out trust. I keep track of who earns it.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.loyalty.02: A deserter can keep their life. They won't keep my respect.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.loyalty.03: You don't need a speech to stand by a crewmate. Just stand there.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.loyalty.04: Betray us once and you'll spend years proving it was a mistake.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.loyalty.05: I'd rather sail with an honest coward than a boastful traitor.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.loyalty.06: Someone has to watch the rear. I always volunteer last.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.rumor.01: Heard about the ghost ship? Good. Now stop chasing it.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.rumor.02: Someone's skimming coins from the shares. I know. They know I know.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.rumor.03: There's a reef north of here that eats anchors. Mark it on your map.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.rumor.04: They call it a cursed harbor. I call it bad maintenance.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.rumor.05: A fishing boat vanished without a storm. That's the part I don't like.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.rumor.06: Rumors get sailors killed faster than swords. Check your sources.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.danger.01: Quit gawking and move those crates!
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.danger.02: If you freeze in a fight, get behind me. Don't pretend you can swing.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.danger.03: Eyes on the horizon. I don't repeat warnings.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.danger.04: That knot comes loose, we're all swimming. Tie it properly.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.danger.05: The next wave will hit hard. Bend your knees.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.danger.06: Save the shouting for when something actually catches fire.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.gift.01: Hmph. Useful. Thanks. Don't make a ceremony of it.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.gift.02: I didn't ask for anything. Still... I'll put it to good use.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.gift.03: This'll last longer than the last thing they gave me.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.gift.04: You've got a decent eye for supplies. I'll give you that.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.gift.05: Keep the fancy wrapping. I prefer things that work.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.gift.06: Thanks. That's all you're getting out of me.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.farewell.01: Watch your footing on the pier. It's rotten.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.farewell.02: Don't die doing something stupid. I'm tired of digging graves.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.farewell.03: If you're coming back, bring nails. We're out.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.farewell.04: Get moving before the tide turns.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.farewell.05: Keep your blade clean and your mouth shut.
piratesmca.dialogue.gruff.farewell.06: You did all right today. Don't let it go to your head.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.greeting.01: You're on the wrong deck, stranger. Explain why you're still standing here.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.greeting.02: I don't remember inviting you aboard.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.greeting.03: One step closer and I'll assume you came looking for a fight.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.greeting.04: Speak quickly. My patience went overboard years ago.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.greeting.05: Look at that. Another fool who mistakes a pirate flag for a welcome sign.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.greeting.06: You have three breaths to tell me your business. Use them wisely.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.smalltalk.01: I don't care where you're from. I care what you brought.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.smalltalk.02: People smile before they betray you. I prefer they skip the smile.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.smalltalk.03: I sleep with one eye open. The other watches the door.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.smalltalk.04: If the crew likes you, that's their mistake to make.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.smalltalk.05: Quiet is the only conversation I enjoy.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.smalltalk.06: There's no honor in hesitation. Only openings for the enemy.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.sea.01: The sea swallows the weak. I don't plan on joining them.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.sea.02: Every wave is a warning. Only idiots wait for the second one.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.sea.03: I've watched a ship disappear in seconds. Yours wouldn't last longer.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.sea.04: The deep keeps what it takes. Stop asking about the missing.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.sea.05: On land, you can run. Out there, the horizon gives you nowhere to hide.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.sea.06: A storm doesn't frighten me. A silent lookout does.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.treasure.01: You touch my share, and our agreement is finished.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.treasure.02: A map in your hands is a map I could take. Remember that.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.treasure.03: Keep staring at my chest and I'll start counting your fingers.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.treasure.04: I didn't cross half an ocean to split the prize with a stranger.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.treasure.05: Every treasure has a guardian. Today, that's me.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.treasure.06: If there's a trap, you can be the one to test it.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.trade.01: Name a fair price. You won't get a second attempt.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.trade.02: I'm buying supplies, not your excuses.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.trade.03: Try cheating me and we stop being business partners.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.trade.04: Your goods look suspiciously like something we lost.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.trade.05: I don't haggle. I decide whether your offer is worth hearing.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.trade.06: Count the emeralds twice. I will.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.captain.01: The captain gives orders. I decide how much respect they deserve.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.captain.02: Weak captains invite mutiny and then act surprised.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.captain.03: I'd follow a fearless captain into fire. A foolish one can go alone.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.captain.04: Every captain has a last order. Some just don't know when they'll give it.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.captain.05: I don't want the wheel. I want the fool holding it to stop trembling.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.captain.06: A captain's title won't protect them from the crew's judgment.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.crew.01: The crew respects strength. Everything else is decoration.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.crew.02: I don't need friends aboard. I need people who follow through.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.crew.03: The next sailor who steals my ration answers to me.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.crew.04: Keep your distance from my bunk and we'll avoid trouble.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.crew.05: If someone can't hold their end of a rope, they can hold a bucket.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.crew.06: We sail under one flag. Don't mistake that for friendship.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.loyalty.01: Betray this crew and no harbor will feel far enough away.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.loyalty.02: I trust deeds. Words are what traitors practice.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.loyalty.03: A broken oath is louder than a cannon. Everyone hears it.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.loyalty.04: If I save you, you owe me the truth. Not a thank-you.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.loyalty.05: I remember every face that ran when the fighting started.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.loyalty.06: You want my loyalty? Give me a reason that survives a bad day.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.rumor.01: There's talk of mutiny. I want names, not whispers.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.rumor.02: A merchant's been selling our routes. I plan to ask them some questions.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.rumor.03: The captain's treasure room was opened last night. Nobody admits it.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.rumor.04: Rumor says a rival crew is coming. Good. Saves us the journey.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.rumor.05: Somebody's been marking our hull at night. That's no sailor's joke.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.rumor.06: If you've heard a name tied to betrayal, speak now.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.danger.01: Draw your blade or get out of my path!
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.danger.02: I warned them once. There won't be another warning.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.danger.03: Keep your head down unless you're ready to fight.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.danger.04: We have enemies to port. Good. I was getting bored.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.danger.05: If you panic, don't drag the rest of us down with you.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.danger.06: That ship crossed the line. Now we show them why it was there.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.gift.01: What do you want in return? Nobody gives me anything for free.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.gift.02: Don't think one gift buys you my trust.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.gift.03: Useful. You might have a purpose aboard after all.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.gift.04: I'll take it. That doesn't mean we're friends.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.gift.05: If this is a trick, you'll regret wasting my time.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.gift.06: At least you know the difference between a gift and an insult.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.farewell.01: Leave. And don't make me say it twice.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.farewell.02: The pier's behind you. Use it while I'm feeling generous.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.farewell.03: Next time, ask permission before stepping onto my deck.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.farewell.04: Keep out of our waters unless you have business worth my time.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.farewell.05: If we meet under another flag, expect a different welcome.
piratesmca.dialogue.hostile.farewell.06: You've survived this conversation. Don't mistake that for an invitation.
dialogue.piratesmca_friendly_voyage_invi: We sail at dawn for an island no chart agrees on. Want to join the adventure?
Count me in. What should I bring?
A good blade, spare food, and something to sing badly. Welcome aboard!
No hard feelings. The sea will still be there when you change your mind.
Probably. But I never leave without enough lifeboats for everyone.
dialogue.piratesmca_friendly_lost_sailor: One of our sailors hasn't returned from the reef. I'm trying not to fear the worst.
Thank you. I'll remember who came when the sea took one of ours.
Near the broken mast, east of the kelp. Take a boat and watch the current.
I understand. Just keep an eye on the shore, will you?
dialogue.piratesmca_friendly_share_the_f: I found an old compass in a wreck. It points somewhere, but not north.
That's the spirit! I'll bring the map; you bring the courage.
You could sell it for emeralds.
Maybe. But some things are worth more as mysteries.
Good call. I'll hide it where even the cook won't find it.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_missing_crate: We're missing a crate of supplies. Everybody claims they saw nothing.
Finally, someone with a working head. Start by the dock.
Maybe. And maybe you ought to bring evidence before accusations.
Fine. Then stop blocking the people who intend to solve it.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_captain_test: So you want to command a crew? Tell me what comes first.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_captain_test.c: Good answer. A captain who forgets that can steer an empty ship.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_captain_test.g: And who carries your gold if the crew ends up on the seabed?
Respect is earned by the work. Don't put the reward before the job.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_damaged_hull: There's a crack in the hull. I need hands, not opinions.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_damaged_hull.b: Good. Dry ones. And a hammer that isn't made of promises.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_damaged_hull.a: Longer if you stop asking and start hauling.
dialogue.piratesmca_gruff_damaged_hull.i: Then you can explain to the sea why it should wait with us.
dialogue.piratesmca_hostile_deck_trespas: You're standing where you don't belong. Give me one reason not to throw you off.
I have business with your captain.
Then say that first. Hands where I can see them.
Fear was never the requirement. Good judgment was.
dialogue.piratesmca_hostile_mutiny_whisp: Someone aboard is plotting against the captain. I don't tolerate cowards hiding behind whispers.
Not yet. That's why I'm watching who flinches when I ask.
Maybe. But if you're stirring a mutiny, own your words.
Then keep your distance. This won't end with a friendly vote.
dialogue.piratesmca_hostile_rival_flag: I know that flag. Their crew took something from us, and I have not forgotten.
dialogue.piratesmca_hostile_rival_flag.o: Maybe we can settle this without a fight.
Try. But don't promise them anything that belongs to my crew.
dialogue.piratesmca_hostile_rival_flag.f: Fine. Stay at my side, and do not break formation.
dialogue.piratesmca_hostile_rival_flag.w: Then get off this deck before you become part of it.
